classes.DETECTION_LOST: visible_top_px * area_ratio_max < min_pixels (8): no blob at all, facts UNKNOWN and the PICK mask FALSE
classes.DETECTION_WEAK: visible_top_px * area_ratio_min (0.816) < min_pixels: detection depends on calibration error
classes.SOFT_OCCLUSION_CANDIDATE: detected for sure and the centroid shift along a world axis >= 0.0119 m (the smaller grasp slack minus the controller tolerance 0.008 m)

sources_of_boundaries: gripper geometry (finger inner face / pad width)
